shortDescription: Manage DNS records in the Micetro

options.name: aging
options.description: The aging timestamp of dynamic records in AD integrated zones. Hours since January 1, 1601, UTC. Providing a non-zero value creates a dynamic record.

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment string for the record. Note that only records in static DNS zones can have a comment string

options.name: data
options.description: The data that is added to the DNS record The record data is a space-separated list when the resource type is one of MX, SRV, NAPTR, CAA, CERT, HINFO, TLSA For MX and SRV the hostname should be the short name and not the FQDN

options.name: dnszone
options.description: The DNS zone where the action should take place.

options.name: enabled
options.description: True if the record is enabled. If the record is disabled the value is false

options.name: mm_provider
options.description: Definition of the Micetro API mm_provider.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the DNS record. Can either be partially or fully qualified.

options.name: rrtype
options.description: Resource Record Type for this DNS record.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The Time-To-Live of the DNS record.
